business_requirement.objective:
KMITORA MIGRATION - BUSINESS RULES
Source: customers.csv / orders.csv -> Target: kmitora_target (PostgreSQL)

UNIQUENESS & IDENTITY
----------------------
BR-001  customer_id must be unique and non-null.
BR-002  order_id must be unique and non-null.

FIELD NORMALIZATION
----------------------
BR-003  customer_name must be trimmed before target mapping.
BR-004  email must be normalized to lowercase.
BR-005  ACTIVE customer status must normalize to A.
BR-006  INACTIVE customer status must normalize to I.
BR-007  SOUTH region must normalize to S.
BR-008  NORTH region must normalize to N.
BR-009  EAST region must normalize to E.
BR-010  WEST region must normalize to W.
BR-011  OPEN order status must normalize to PENDING.
BR-012  COMPLETED order status must remain COMPLETED.
BR-013  CANCELLED order status must remain CANCELLED.

VALUE VALIDATION
----------------------
BR-014  customer balance must be non-negative.
BR-015  order amount must be greater than zero.
BR-016  order_date must not be a future date relative to the migration run date.

REFERENTIAL INTEGRITY
----------------------
BR-017  every order must reference an existing customer_id.
BR-018  no order may be loaded whose parent customer failed migration.

GOVERNANCE & SEQUENCING
----------------------
BR-019  source data must remain read-only.
BR-020  only validated records may proceed toward the DEV target.
BR-021  Customers must be processed before Orders (dependency-ordered load).
BR-022  re-running the migration must not create duplicate customer_id/order_id rows (idempotent load).

RECONCILIATION & EVIDENCE
----------------------
BR-023  source and target record counts must reconcile for both customers and orders.
BR-024  SUM(amount) per customer_id must reconcile between source and target.
BR-025  evidence must capture mappings, transformations, validation, load and reconciliation.

NOTE
----------------------
Payment-related rules are not included since the current source data
(customers.csv / orders.csv) has no payments table. If a payments.csv
is added later (Customers -> Orders -> Payments, matching KGP-002),
this list should be extended with payment reference-integrity and
value-validation rules.
